summary: Implemented all five plan phases: a new lean-challenge-observe.sh post-task observer produces the Lean Challenge snapshot at plan-time (resting_status planned, no --force) and consumes --check at the implement-side resting statuses, registered in manifest.json's observers block and documented in README.md. Extended both regression suites (29 and 41 passing cases). The design record (challenge-snapshot.md) and plan-compliance.md now record every ruling the originating change request asked for: registration rationale, re-plan REFUSE behavior, the declined --check promotion, the timeout/project_root limitations, and the structural commit-volume side effect. Two now-false header comments in lean-challenge-snapshot.sh were corrected, comment-only. The derived index-entries.json line_count was reconciled and the deployed tree matches the source store.

artifacts.summary: Implementation summary covering all five phases: observer authoring and suite, manifest registration, end-to-end deployment/firing verification, design-record/rule updates with header corrections, and index reconciliation.
